versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Salamander smiths pile Heat (fight-only Attack) on a few units, using board position to heat each other.
Quenching turns Heat into permanent stats; selling units melts them into Heat, and Heat works on any tribe.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Fixed unclear wording: Heat always lasts (no more 'permanently'), Quench-Bucket says whose neighbours heat, Konrad's return is optional and keeps stats.
Capped Warden Quench's gold at 2 a turn to stop the golden Nutrisco gold loop; Bellows Boy now heats backwards from the front row.

stop_reason: 3 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
